courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 雪梨港灣大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「合龍的力學意義」與「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雪梨港灣大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "What closure means structurally" and "System transfer and tieback release monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sydney Harbour Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從懸臂半拱到完整拱的體系轉換：扣索控制、溫度窗口、合龍段接合與卸載監測；雪梨港灣大橋則以以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the system change from cantilevered half-arches to a complete arch: tieback control, temperature windows, closure joints and release monitoring; Sydney Harbour Bridge centres on carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「合龍前後的體系轉換」與「雙鉸拱支承」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雪梨港灣大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「1932 年機車載重試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “System change at closure” and “Two-hinged arch bearings”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sydney Harbour Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The 1932 locomotive load test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼拱橋拱肋合龍
history.text: 以懸臂方式架設大跨度鋼拱、再於拱頂合龍的做法在二十世紀初逐漸成熟。1930 年雪梨港灣大橋以兩岸岩盤隧道錨碇 128 條鋼索支撐半拱，逐步放鬆錨索讓兩半拱在 8 月 19 日接合；1976 年新河峽大橋以纜索吊運、油井套管背拉索與 16 具 1,250 噸液壓千斤頂下放合龍；2002 年上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設 550 公尺拱跨並於 10 月合龍，之後重慶朝天門大橋把鋼桁拱跨度推到 552 公尺。這些案例的共同課題都是扣索控制、溫度窗口與體系轉換的量測驗證。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: Cantilevering long-span steel arches and closing them at the crown matured in the early twentieth century. In 1930 Sydney Harbour Bridge held its half-arches back with 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels and gradually released them until the halves met on 19 August; in 1976 New River Gorge Bridge used a cableway, oil-well-casing tiebacks and sixteen 1,250-ton hydraulic jacks to lower its arms to closure; in 2002 Shanghai's Lupu Bridge cantilevered a 550 m arch on temporary cable stays and closed it in October, and Chongqing's Chaotianmen Bridge later pushed the steel truss arch span to 552 m. Common to all are tieback control, temperature windows and measured verification of the system change. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.
